senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (मिलति or मिलति-ते)
To be connected or united with, to mix, to associate.

r. 1st cl. (मीलति)
To wink or twinkle, to close or contract the eye-lids: with उत् prefixed, to awake, (and figuratively) to expand, to bud, to blossom.

n. (-नं)
1 Mixing with, being in contact with, associating with, &c.
2 Encountering, meeting.
E.
मिल to mix, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Twinkling, blinking, winking.
E.
मील to twinkle, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Mixed, united, combined or connected with.
2 Found, met with, encountered.
E.
मिल to mix, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Twinkled.
2 Unblown, partly opened, as a young bud, &c.
n. (-तं)
Indirect allusion or description, (in rhetoric.)
E.
मील to twinkle, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
Winking, twinkling, closing, (as the eyes.)
E.
मील to wink, शतृ aff.
